title: Why the Counterintuitive Phenomenon of Likelihood Rarely Appears in Tabular Anomaly Detection with Deep Generative Models?
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical investigation of anomaly detection in tabular datasets using deep generative models, specifically Normalizing Flows.
